# SPARQL.ex v0.3.12 - Table of Contents

An implementation of SPARQL for Elixir.

## Pages

- [About](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [CHANGELOG](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/contributing.md)
- [License](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [SPARQL](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.md): An implementation of the [SPARQL](http://www.w3.org/TR/sparql11-overview/) standard for Elixir.

- [SPARQL.Algebra.BGP](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.BGP.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.Construct](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.Construct.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.Distinct](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.Distinct.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.Expression](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.Expression.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.Extend](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.Extend.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.Filter](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.Filter.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.FunctionCall](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.FunctionCall.md): Shared functions for builtin and extension function calls.

- [SPARQL.Algebra.FunctionCall.Builtin](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.FunctionCall.Builtin.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.FunctionCall.Extension](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.FunctionCall.Extension.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.Join](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.Join.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.LeftJoin](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.LeftJoin.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.Minus](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.Minus.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.Project](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.Project.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.Reduced](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.Reduced.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.Translation](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.Translation.md): Translation of ASTs of the `SPARQL.Language.Decoder` into a `SPARQL.Algebra.Expression`.
- [SPARQL.Algebra.Translation.GroupGraphPattern](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.Translation.GroupGraphPattern.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.Translation.OptionalGraphPattern](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.Translation.OptionalGraphPattern.md)
- [SPARQL.Algebra.Union](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Algebra.Union.md)
- [SPARQL.ExtensionFunction](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.md): A behaviour for SPARQL extension functions.
- [SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.md): <Undocumented>
- [SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registry](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registry.md): A registry of all available `SPARQL.ExtensionFunction`s.

- [SPARQL.Functions.Builtins](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Builtins.md)
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.md)
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Boolean](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Boolean.md): An `SPARQL.ExtensionFunction` for the `xsd:boolean` XPath constructor function.
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Boolean.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Boolean.Registration](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Boolean.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Boolean.Registration.md)
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Date](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Date.md): An `SPARQL.ExtensionFunction` for the `xsd:date` XPath constructor function.
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Date.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Date.Registration](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Date.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Date.Registration.md)
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.DateTime](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.DateTime.md): An `SPARQL.ExtensionFunction` for the `xsd:dateTime` XPath constructor function.
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.DateTime.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.DateTime.Registration](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.DateTime.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.DateTime.Registration.md)
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Decimal](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Decimal.md): An `SPARQL.ExtensionFunction` for the `xsd:decimal` XPath constructor function.
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Decimal.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Decimal.Registration](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Decimal.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Decimal.Registration.md)
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Double](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Double.md): An `SPARQL.ExtensionFunction` for the `xsd:double` XPath constructor function.
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Double.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Double.Registration](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Double.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Double.Registration.md)
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Float](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Float.md): An `SPARQL.ExtensionFunction` for the `xsd:float` XPath constructor function.
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Float.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Float.Registration](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Float.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Float.Registration.md)
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Integer](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Integer.md): An `SPARQL.ExtensionFunction` for the `xsd:integer` XPath constructor function.
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Integer.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Integer.Registration](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Integer.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Integer.Registration.md)
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.String](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.String.md): An `SPARQL.ExtensionFunction` for the `xsd:string` XPath constructor function.
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.String.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.String.Registration](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.String.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.String.Registration.md)
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Time](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Time.md): An `SPARQL.ExtensionFunction` for the `xsd:time` XPath constructor function.
- [SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Time.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Time.Registration](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Time.SPARQL.ExtensionFunction.Registration.SPARQL.Functions.Cast.Time.Registration.md)
- [SPARQL.Language](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Language.md): An implementation of the SPARQL 1.1 query language.
- [SPARQL.Language.Decoder](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Language.Decoder.md)
- [SPARQL.Language.ParseHelper](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Language.ParseHelper.md)
- [SPARQL.Processor](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Processor.md): Context module for the SPARQL processor executing SPARQL queries and updates.

- [SPARQL.Query](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Query.md): A structure for SPARQL queries.

- [SPARQL.Query.Result](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Query.Result.md)
- [SPARQL.Query.Result.CSV](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Query.Result.CSV.md): An implementation of the W3C Recommendation for the SPARQL 1.1 Query Results CSV Formats.
- [SPARQL.Query.Result.Format](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Query.Result.Format.md): A behaviour for SPARQL query result formats.
- [SPARQL.Query.Result.Format.Decoder](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Query.Result.Format.Decoder.md): A behaviour for decoders of strings encoded in a specific `SPARQL.Query.Result.Format`.

- [SPARQL.Query.Result.Format.Encoder](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Query.Result.Format.Encoder.md): A behaviour for encoders of `SPARQL.Query.Result`s in a specific `SPARQL.Query.Result.Format`s.

- [SPARQL.Query.Result.JSON](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Query.Result.JSON.md): An implementation of the W3C Recommendation for the SPARQL 1.1 Query Results JSON Format.
- [SPARQL.Query.Result.TSV](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Query.Result.TSV.md): An implementation of the W3C Recommendation for the SPARQL 1.1 Query Results TSV Formats.
- [SPARQL.Query.Result.Turtle](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Query.Result.Turtle.md): An implementation of the Turtle serialization of SPARQL Query Results used in some W3C SPARQL tests.

- [SPARQL.Query.Result.Turtle.NS](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Query.Result.Turtle.NS.md)
- [SPARQL.Query.Result.Turtle.NS.RS](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Query.Result.Turtle.NS.RS.md)
- [SPARQL.Query.Result.XML](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/SPARQL.Query.Result.XML.md): An implementation of the W3C Recommendation for the SPARQL 1.1 Query Results XML Format.
- [TSV](https://sparql.hexdocs.pm/TSV.md)
